description:
Introduces new Utf8.createReader() and Utf8.createWriter() helper methods that explicitly use UTF-8 encoding when creating FileReaders and FileWriters. Updates IOUtils and migrates existing code to use explicit UTF-8 encoding instead of relying on platform default encoding.

@bjorncs please review

comments.body: The new public helper methods lack JavaDoc documentation. Other public methods in the Utf8 class consistently include JavaDoc comments. Add JavaDoc describing the purpose of these methods (to create FileReaders/FileWriters with UTF-8 encoding), their parameters, return values, and exceptions thrown. For example, see the pattern used for other methods like codePointAsUtf8Length (lines 543-548).

The new createReader and createWriter helper methods lack test coverage. The Utf8TestCase has comprehensive testing for other Utf8 methods, so tests should be added for these new public API methods to verify they correctly create FileReaders and FileWriters with UTF-8 encoding, and to ensure proper exception handling.

The comment "Creates a buffered reader in the default encoding" is misleading after this change. The method now explicitly uses UTF-8 encoding, not the platform default. Update the comment to say "Creates a buffered reader using UTF-8 encoding" or similar to reflect the actual behavior.
```suggestion
    /** Creates a buffered reader using UTF-8 encoding */
```
